annotations:
    node:

    - name: truncateBefore
      type: boolean
      description: 𝗧𝗥𝗨𝗡𝗖𝗔𝗧𝗘 the target table before inserting. 𝗜𝗴𝗻𝗼𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗻 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀.
      isRequired: false      
      default: true

    - name: testsEnabled
      type: boolean
      description: Controls whether configured tests are executed.
      isRequired: false
      default: true

    - name: tests
      description: The test fails if the query returns any records. Applicable only when 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘀𝗘𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗱 is enabled.
      allowsMultiple: true
      parameters:
        - name: querySQL
          type: string
          description: SQL statement to execute as a validation test.
          isRequired: true
          example: 'SELECT 1'

        - name: runOrder
          type: string
          description: Determines whether the test is executed before or after the load operation.
          isRequired: false
          default: After
          options:
            - Before
            - After

        - name: continueOnFailure
          type: boolean
          description: Determines whether execution continues when the test fails.
          isRequired: false
          default: true
          parameters:
          options:
            - true
            - false

    - name: preSQL
      description: SQL statement to execute before data load operation. 𝗜𝗴𝗻𝗼𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗻 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀.
      allowsMultiple: true
      parameters:
      - name: querySQL
        type: string
        description: Query to be executed.
        isRequired: true
        example: 'SELECT 1'

    - name: postSQL
      description: SQL statement to execute after data load operation. 𝗜𝗴𝗻𝗼𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗻 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀.
      allowsMultiple: true
      parameters:
      - name: querySQL
        type: string
        description: Query to be executed.
        isRequired: true
        example: 'SELECT 1'

    column:

    - name: inHash
      description: Marks columns for hash key generation. Use the 𝐠𝐞𝐭_𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐡() macro to generate the hash column from the marked columns. 𝗦𝗲𝗲 𝗱𝗼𝗰𝘂𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀.
      allowsMultiple: true
      parameters:
        - name: hashName
          isRequired: true
          type: string
          description: Common name assigned to the generated hash.
          example: GH_COL

        - name: hashOrder
          isRequired: true
          type: number
          description: Order of columns used to calculate the hash.
          example: 1

    - name: tests
      description: Column level tests for data quality requirements. Either or both tests can be specified based on validation requirements. Order of specification does not matter. Applicable only when 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘀𝗘𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗱 is applied.
      allowsMultiple: true
      isRequired: false
      parameters:
        - name: type
          type: string
          description: |
            Column level data quality requirement type.
            ➤ 𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐪𝐮𝐞: Checks to ensure all values are 𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗤𝗨𝗘.
            ➤ 𝐧𝐮𝐥𝐥: Ensures the column contains no 𝗡𝗨𝗟𝗟 values. |
          isRequired: true
          parameters:
          options:
            - 'unique'
            - 'null'
